newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - Australia's Optus Vision CEO to step down.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Australia's Optus Vision CEO to step down.

text.p: Optus Vision chief executive Geoffrey Cousins said on Thursday he would step down as chief executive in the coming months and would become chairman of the Australian pay television operator
"I'm now going to step aside as CEO and as soon as we find a replacement, directors have offered the position of chairman and I'll be taking up that position," Cousins told reporters.
Cousins said Optus Vision would not look overseas for his replacement as chief executive.
"I'm not a great fan of this trend of hiring chief executives for Australian firms by hiring from overseas," Cousins said.
"We won't be looking at any overseas candidates. I don't understand that trend and I don't think it's a healthy one."
He said that a replacement would be found quickly, possibly within weeks or a couple of months.
Optus Vision is 46.5 percent owned by both Australian telecommunications carrier Optus Communications and Continental CableVision Inc, which has merged with U.S. West.
Optus Communications is 25 percent owned by Mayne Nickless Ltd, and 24.5 percent owned each by BellSouth Corp and Cable and Wireless Plc.
The balance of Optus Vision is owned by Seven Network Ltd and Publishing and Broadcasting Ltd.
